spans.s:
n. (-टं)
Indistinct speech.
mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
1 Indistinct, obscure.
2

Unblown.
E.
अ neg. and स्फुट open, clear.

n. (-लं)
1 Indistinct result.
2 (In Geometry,) Gross area of a triangle, &c.
E.
अस्फुट and फल fruit.

mfn. (-वाक्)
Lisping, speaking indistinctly.
E.
अस्फट and वाच् who speaks.

m. (-लः)
1 Striking, rubbing, causing to move gently.
2 Flapping, clapping.
3 The flapping motion of an elephant's ear.
E.
आङ्, स्फल to move, causal form, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Pride, arrogance.
2 Rubbing, stirring, moving gently.
E.
आङ् before स्फल to move, causal form, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Struck gently, rubbed, touched, stirred.
2 Flapped, clapped, struck together.
E.
आङ् before स्फल to move, causal form, क्त aff.

m. (-जित्)
A name of ŚUKRA, regent of the planet VENUS, and teacher of the Asuras.

m. (-टः)
1 A plant, (Swallow wort.)
2 The sound of striking on the arms, as made by combatants, wrestlers, &c.
f. (-टा)
A wild variety of jasmin.
E.
आङ्, स्फुट् to expand, and अच् affix; also आस्फोत^1 and आस्फोता.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161130. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 301.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Careya arborea.)
E.
आङ्, स्फुट् to blow, &c. and वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Blowing, expanding.
2 Contracting, closing.
3 Slapping the arms, or the noise made by it.
f. (-नी)
A gimlet or auger.
E.
आङ्, स्फुट to blow or expand, and ल्युट् aff.

m. (-तः)
1 Swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea.)
2 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.)
3 A kind of echites or savanna flower, (E. dichotoma, Rox.)
f. (-ता)
1 A wild variety of jasmin.
2 Clitoria ternatea.
E.
आङ्, स्फुट to blow or expend, अच् affix and ट changed to त; or स्फै to encrease, with क्त affix, and आ converted to ओ; also sometimes आस्फोट and आस्फोटा.
